aiResearchSummary.text: Hamming AI is focused on developing systems for secure updating of machine learning models. This involves a processing device that generates requests and updates models using encryption devices to ensure security. The research also includes encryption retransmission devices for IIoT, enhancing resiliency against attacks by encrypting data and adding headers for secure communication. These efforts highlight Hamming AI's commitment to building reliable AI products through secure and resilient data handling and model updating processes.
